title: stelis croatii
intro: Stelis croatii, commonly known as the orchid of the forest, is a species of orchid found in Central America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with benefits including the reduction of inflammation and pain, as well as its potential to treat various infections. The therapeutic actions of Stelis croatii include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as fever and arthritis. The bioactive constituents of this plant are largely unknown but are believed to include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
